summary: The recorded base reproduces the original DFLASH/DSPARK page_size=1 defect: req_to_token headroom is 21 slots while the decode reserve is 34 slots for 17 draft tokens. The exact candidate commit widens DFLASH-family rows for the reserve at every page size and adds a pre-allocation row-width assertion. Its submitted tests pass, and independent sizing and exact-boundary adversarial checks found no counterexample to the reported source-level contract.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1cf380832dc9/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' (base sizing matrix for DSPARK/DFLASH, page sizes 1, 2, and 16)
tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163, DSPARK and DFLASH at page_size=1 each returned extra=21 and reserve=34 (invariant false); page sizes 2 and 16 covered reserve plus alignment.
At candidate 34f94a1, all six submitted DFLASH/DSPARK sizing, guard, non-spec, alignment, and UNO regression tests passed.

At candidate 34f94a1, 50 DFLASH-family combinations across draft counts 1, 2, 17, 64, 257 and page sizes 1, 2, 3, 16, 256 covered reserve plus alignment; unrelated page-size-one algorithms retained baseline sizing; reserved length 134 was rejected at row width 133 and accepted at exact width 134.
The candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The prepared interpreter enumerated one AMD Instinct MI350X with gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. No compatible DFLASH/DSPARK target and draft weights were provided, so no issue-specific live serving or GPU numerical workload was run.

remaining_limitations: The reported live 4x B200 workload, cross-request row corruption, leaked-slot count, and delayed idle leak were not reproduced on the assigned single gfx950 GPU.
No compatible DFLASH/DSPARK model weights were available; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify this speculative architecture and was therefore not used as substitute proof.
The review verifies the exact source-level sizing invariant and fail-fast boundary behavior, not model semantic accuracy, NVIDIA behavior, or a distributed workload.
No native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.
